topics.title: Meaning of depreciation, depletion and amortisation

concepts.learning_objective: Explain depreciation as the expired cost of a fixed asset allocated over its useful life, and state its features.
Distinguish depreciation from depletion of natural resources and amortisation of intangible assets.

topics.title: Causes of and need for depreciation

concepts.learning_objective: Identify wear and tear, expiry of legal rights, obsolescence and abnormal factors as causes of depreciation.
Explain why depreciation is charged: matching, tax, true and fair position and compliance with law.

topics.title: Factors affecting the amount of depreciation

concepts.learning_objective: Determine the cost of a fixed asset including all expenses to put it in working condition.
Calculate net residual value and depreciable cost of an asset.
Explain the estimated useful life of an asset and how it differs from physical life.

topics.title: Straight line and written down value methods

concepts.learning_objective: Compute annual depreciation and its rate under the straight line method.
Compute depreciation and book value under the written down value method.
Compare the straight line and written down value methods on basis, charge, tax recognition and suitability.

topics.title: Recording depreciation, disposal and additions to assets

concepts.learning_objective: Record depreciation by charging it to the asset account or through a provision for depreciation account.
Record the sale of an asset and compute the profit or loss on its disposal.
Apply AS-6 (Revised) to depreciation on additions and extensions to an existing asset.
Explain provisions as charges against profit for known liabilities or losses of uncertain amount.
Calculate and record a provision for doubtful debts after writing off bad debts.
Distinguish a reserve, an appropriation of profit, from a provision, a charge against profit.
Classify reserves as general or specific and as revenue or capital reserves.
Explain how a secret reserve is created and its effect on disclosed profits.
